+<p dir="auto">When contributing, post comments and discuss changes you wish to make via Issues.</p>
+<p dir="auto">Feel free to propose changes by creating Pull Requests. If you don't have write access, editing a file will create a Fork of this project for you to save your proposed changes to. Submitting a change to a file will write it to a new Branch in your Fork, so you can send a Pull Request.</p>
+<p dir="auto">If this is your first time contributing on GitHub, don't worry! Let us know if you have any questions.</p>

+<p dir="auto">Lorsque vous contribuez, veuillez également publier des commentaires et discuter des modifications que vous souhaitez apporter par l'entremise des enjeux (Issues).</p>
+<p dir="auto">N'hésitez pas à proposer des modifications en créant des demandes de tirage (Pull Requests). Si vous n'avez pas accès au mode de rédaction, la modification d'un fichier créera une copie (Fork) de ce projet afin que vous puissiez enregistrer les modifications que vous proposez. Le fait de proposer une modification à un fichier l'écrira dans une nouvelle branche dans votre copie (Fork), de sorte que vous puissiez envoyer une demande de tirage (Pull Request).</p>
+<p dir="auto">Si c'est la première fois que vous contribuez à GitHub, ne vous en faites pas! Faites-nous part de vos questions.</p>

+<p dir="auto">This project will host the minimum guardrails as part of the GC Cloud Operationalization Framework for Oracle. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is an approved Cloud Service Provider.</p>
+<p dir="auto">The purpose of the guardrails is to ensure that departments and agencies are implementing a preliminary baseline set of controls within their cloud-based environments.</p>
+<p dir="auto">These minimum guardrails are to be implemented within the GC-specified initial period (e.g. 30 days) upon receipt of an enrollment under the GC Cloud Services Framework Agreement.</p>
+<p dir="auto">This <a href="https://github.com/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-oracle/blob/main/docs/Guardrails%20Implementation%20Guidance%20for%20Oracle%20Cloud%20-%20EN%20(Dec%202020).pdf">document</a> provides a brief overview of each applicable guardrail and instructions on how to implement them when using OCI.</p>
+<p dir="auto">For a quicker way to deploy a secure environment fit for the Guardrails on OCI, be sure to use the OCI Landing Zone accelerator.
+See <a href="https://github.com/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-oracle/tree/main/oci-cis-landingzone-quickstart">OCI Landing Zone Quickstart</a></p>
+<p dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-oracle/blob/main/docs/OCI%20Cloud%20Guardrails%20-%20EN.pdf">OCI Prowler</a> is a command-line tool that can be used to validate the guardrails implementation.</p>

+<p dir="auto">Ce projet hébergera les garde-corps minimums dans le cadre de l’opérationnalisation de l’informatique en nuage du GC pour Oracle. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) est un fournisseur de services cloud approuvé.</p>
+<p dir="auto">Le but des garde-corps est de garantir que les ministères et organismes mettent en œuvre un ensemble de base de contrôle préliminaire dans leurs environnements cloud.
+Ces garde-corps minimaux doivent être mis en œuvre au cours de la période initiale spécifiée par le GC (par exemple, 30 jours) à la réception d'une inscription en vertu de l'Accord-cadre des services cloud du GC.</p>
+<p dir="auto">Ce <a href="https://github.com/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-oracle/blob/main/docs/Guardrails%20Implementation%20Guidance%20for%20Oracle%20Cloud%20-%20FR%20(Dec%202020).pdf">document</a> fournit un bref aperçu de chaque garde-corps applicable et des instructions sur la façon de les mettre en œuvre lors de l'utilisation d'OCI.</p>
+<p dir="auto">Pour un moyen plus rapide de déployer un environnement sécurisé adapté aux garde-corps sur OCI, assurez-vous d'utiliser l'accélérateur OCI Landing Zone.
+Voir <a href="https://github.com/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-oracle/tree/main/oci-cis-landingzone-quickstart">Démarrage rapide de la zone d'atterrissage OCI</a></p>
+<p dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-oracle/blob/main/docs/OCI%20Cloud%20Guardrails%20-%20FR.pdf">OCI Prowler</a> est un outil de ligne de commande qui peut être utilisé pour valider l’implémentation des garde-corps.</p>

# GC Cloud Guardrails Checks for Google Cloud Platform

This repository will provide the tools required to validate the minimum guardrails for the GC Cloud Operationalization Framework for Google Cloud Platform

## GC Guardrails

The following tables contains the list of [Cloud Guardrails](https://github.com/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails) that will be by followed by the [accelerator templates](#gc-guardrails-accelerator-templates) and validated by the [GC Guardrails tool](#gc-guardrails-validation). 

| Guardrail | Description | Enforcement | Link |
|----|----|----| --- |
| 01 Protect Root / Global Admins Account | Protect root or master account used to establish the cloud service. | Doc | [link](./guardrails/01-mfa-validation/guardrail-1-mfa.md)  |
| 02 Management of Administrative Privileges | Establish access control policies and procedures for management of administrative privileges | Doc | [link](./guardrails/02-management-administration-privileges/management-administration-privileges.md)   |
| 03 Cloud Console Access | Limit access to GC managed devices and authorized users. | Doc | [link](./guardrails/03-cloud-console-access/cloud-console-access.md)  |
| 04 Enterprise Monitoring Accounts | Create role-based account to enable enterprise monitoring and visibility. | Rego | [link](guardrails/04-monitoring-account/04-monitoring-account.md) |
| 05 Data Location | Establish policies to restrict GC sensitive workloads to approved geographic locations. | Rego | [link](guardrails/05-data-location/guardrail-6-data-location.md) |
| 06 Protection of Data-At-Rest | Protect data at rest by default (e.g. storage) for cloud-based workloads. | Doc | [link](./guardrails/06-data-at-rest/guardrail-6-at-rest.md) |
| 07 Protection of Data-In-Transit | Protect data transiting networks through the use of appropriate encryption and network safeguards. | Doc | [link](./guardrails/07-data-in-transit/guardrail-7-in-transit.md) |
| 08 Segment and Separate | Segment and separate information based on sensitivity of information. | Rego | [link](./guardrails/08-segment-separate/guardrail-8-segment-separate.md) |
| 09 Network Security Services | Establish external and internal network perimeters and monitor network traffic.| Rego | [Link](./guardrails/09_Limit_egress_traffic/guardrails-9-network-security-services.md) |
| 10 Cyber Defence Services | Establish MOU for defensive services and threat monitoring protection services. | MOU |
| 11 Logging and Monitoring | Enable logging for the cloud environment and for cloud-based workloads. | Rego | [Link](./guardrails/11-logging-and-monitoring/guardrail-11-logging-monitoring.md) |
| 12 Configuration of Cloud Marketplaces | Configuration of Cloud Market Places | Rego | [Link](./guardrails/12-market-place/guardrail-12-marketplace.md) |


## GC Guardrails Accelerator Templates

Accellerator templates to be used with bootstrapping new environments to comply with the above guardrails can be found in the following repository: [gc guardrails accelerator gcp](https://github.com/canada-ca/accelerators_accelerateurs-gcp)


## GC Guardrails Validation

Makes use of [Open Policy Agent](https://www.openpolicyagent.org/) and GCP's [Asset Invetory API](https://cloud.google.com/asset-inventory) to validate compliance of deployed resources.

See [documentation](guardrails-validation/README.md)
